name: BGH251F2 destruction
doc: BGH251F2's destruction (enemy attack 119, BGH251F2 (Damaged) c0m102, on itself): the module draws the caster with 45 pose entries that 3 bone scripts move, turn and shatter: its bone groups' polygons fly off as fragments (small meshes with their texture) spinning, falling, bouncing and fading, a mark flipbook where each started; layouts and sprites at its bones; the caster sinking at the end, the sound and its voice, the music faded; no damage. Effect 290's and 308's kin. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag298_bgh251f2_destruction.cpp) run on the program's memory (its master's pose, fragments and marks in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Master
parts.doc: The master's ticks, the start sound and the voice (claimed at the start, released near the end), the caster sinking at the end; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Bone scripts
parts.doc: The 3 bone scripts: each moves the caster's 45 pose entries (offsets, turns, their speeds, a bounce on the ground), shatters bone groups into fragments (bones, count, speed, size, chance), spawns layouts and sprites at bones, loops

parts.title: Body
parts.doc: The caster drawn by the module with the pose entries (its shadow, then its bones)

parts.title: Fragments
parts.doc: The shattered polygons: fragments of up to 12 of them on a small mesh, flying off along their normal, spinning, falling, bouncing, fading out

parts.title: Marks
parts.doc: A flipbook where each fragment started, drifting the same way (two kinds)

parts.title: Layouts
parts.doc: The scripts' layouts at a bone, turned, scaled

parts.title: Sprites
parts.doc: The scripts' sprites at a bone (one, or a random burst), drifting, accelerating
